capabilities: Expand inline prompt macros with AI completions
Stream responses in place with animated highlighting
Configure any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and model
Encrypt the API key at rest per device
Customize delimiters, system prompt, and context length
disambiguation: Not a template or automation macro engine; its "macros" are AI prompts typed in the note that expand into generated text.
extras: README warns that each fired macro sends the prompt plus up to 1500 characters of preceding note text to the configured provider and advises checking the provider's data-retention policy; the API key is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and no telemetry is sent. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run AI prompts from inside a note and have the answer replace the prompt text in place.

relations.evidence: You can point this at OpenAI, a local server (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, etc.)

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or other provider)

summary: Inline AI macro plugin that expands typed prompts in a note into streaming responses from an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.
